chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him): When the people gathered to him and complained about what they held against Uthman, and asked him to speak to him and admonish him for their sake, he entered upon Uthman and said:

key_terms.اسْتِعْتَابَهُ: Admonishing him / seeking his excuse or repentance
key_terms.عُثْمَانَ: Uthman ibn Affan, the third Rashidun Caliph
key_terms.نَقَمُوهُ: What they held against him / grievances

ai.seo_question: What did the people ask Imam Ali to do regarding Uthman?
ai.summary: This incident, recorded in Nahj al-Balagha, highlights Imam Ali’s (AS) role as the mediator between the people and the Caliph, demonstrating his methodical approach to resolving grievances through direct dialogue rather than immediate force. It underscores the Shia scholarly view of Ali’s patience and political acumen during the early fitna, as he sought to rectify Uthman’s administrative errors before escalating the conflict. The event serves as a key example of the Imam’s adherence to protocol while advocating for justice on behalf of the community.
